states: Before the fix, searching 315 retained 8 of 50 nodes while the guest table showed only 3 matching guests
The five false parent nodes were admitted only by opaque VM or LXC resource ids containing 315
After the fix, searching 315 retained exactly Analytics A, Analytics F, and East Production E for the three visible guest matches
The same exact three-node result rendered at 390x844 with document clientWidth and scrollWidth both equal to 390 pixels
Direct navigation back to the unfiltered overview restored all 50 nodes and the browser console remained free of warnings and errors

Compared the Nodes and Guests results before and after the search-vocabulary correction
Repeated the numeric search at a 390x844 viewport and checked the three expected parent nodes plus page overflow dimensions
